lyrics:
[00:00.458]Lyrics：Coulson Fan
[00:00.749]Songwriter：Coulson Fan
[00:00.981]Producer：Coulson Fan
[00:01.167]Album Art Cover Design：Coulson Fan
[00:01.549]Aquarius, I show up deep, then I disappear for days
[00:04.468]Not ‘cause I don’t miss you—I just hate the push-and-pull phase
[00:09.169]I’m the one who texts “you good?” to everyone at 2 a.m.
[00:13.671]Then I leave my own heart on read like it’s not my problem
[00:19.726]I’m laughing with the crew, acting like I’m made of chrome
[00:22.206]But when the night goes quiet, I hate going home alone
[00:24.374]I talk about the future like it’s playing on a screen
[00:26.705]But ask me how I’m feeling… and I’m suddenly a dream
[00:29.058]Hold that thought, I’m drifting out of reach tonight
[00:33.955]Don’t blink—‘cause I might open up, then I might
[00:39.600]Aquarius, I’m ice with a neon heart
[00:42.996]I keep it cool, but I fall too hard
[00:45.447]I want the truth, but I fear the strings
[00:47.641]Love me free—don’t clip my wings
[00:49.983]I’m the therapist, but I still need saving
[00:52.683]I act unbothered, but I’m still craving
[00:55.166]I’m Aquarius… baby, I’m strange but true
[00:59.208]True, true… (ooh)
[01:01.993]Strange but true… (yeah)
[01:06.476]Same me,
[01:08.020]Aquarius…
[01:10.420]Aquarius…
[01:12.893]Aquarius…
[01:15.066]I’m strange but true
[01:17.754]I can be the calm when your world’s on fire
[01:20.147]Then go silent when I’m scared to desire
[01:22.560]I overthink like it’s part of my nature
[01:25.043]Then flirt like I don’t care for the danger
[01:27.225]I love big talks, hate small rules
[01:29.809]I’ll break the pattern just to feel the cool
[01:32.258]I read your eyes like they’re galaxy weather
[01:34.587]Say “I’m fine”… while I’m falling together
[01:36.935]Hold that thought, I’m switching planets in my head
[01:41.171]Don’t blink—‘cause I might say “I’m yours,” then I might
[01:45.863]Pull back into my orbit like I’m scared of the light
[01:50.553]Come back like a comet—right on time, outta sight
[01:56.339]Aquarius, I’m ice with a neon heart
[01:59.851]I keep it cool, but I fall too hard
[02:02.368]I want the truth, but I fear the strings
[02:04.537]Love me free—don’t clip my wings
[02:06.762]I’m the therapist, but I still need saving
[02:09.467]I act unbothered, but I’m still craving
[02:11.918]I’m hard to pin, but I’m hard to lose
[02:15.611]Aquarius, I’m ice with a neon heart
[02:19.133]I keep it cool, but I fall too hard
[02:21.383]I want the truth, but I fear the strings
[02:24.581]Love me free—don’t clip my wings
[02:29.555]I’m Aquarius… baby, I’m strange but true
[02:34.191]I don’t lie—I just leave when it gets heavy
[02:36.547]Smile on the surface, inside I’m unsteady
[02:38.812]I hate being owned, I hate being needed
[02:41.037]But I hate it more when you stop believing
[02:44.325]If you can love me without a label on it
[02:46.805]If you can hold me without trying to lock it
[02:49.177]I’ll come back soft, I’ll come back steady
[02:51.207]Cosmic in my head… but my heart is ready
[02:54.152]Aquarius, I’m ice with a neon heart

[03:07.247]I act unbothered, but I’m still craving

[03:13.147]Neon heart… same glow (ooh)
[03:15.464]Don’t hold tight… just hold close
[03:17.758]Aquarius…
[03:19.916]I'm Strange but true
[03:22.587]Cold outside… warm inside
[03:24.903]No chains… just a ride
[03:27.617]Aquarius…
[03:29.678]Strange but true… that’s me
